component.name: WingDrive
component.summary: Browse, organize and sync your files across devices

description.p: WingDrive is a file manager that indexes your folders, drives and cloud accounts into one library and keeps it in sync between your devices over a direct, encrypted connection.

ul.li: Browse local, removable, network and cloud locations in one place
Find duplicates and see which files exist on only one device
Copy, move and trash files with preview and undo
Send files to a paired device with Wingdrop
